regulatory_authority.value: Colorado DOR Natural Medicine Division (businesses) and DORA (facilitators)

legal_basis.value: Natural Medicine Health Act (Prop 122) as amended by SB23-290: C.R.S. 12-170-104(12)(a) (psilocybin, psilocyn); C.R.S. 18-18-434 (personal use)

access_pathway_details.text: Colorado licenses healing centres, cultivations, manufacturers and testing facilities (DOR) and facilitators (DORA) for regulated psilocybin services. Adults 21 and older may also cultivate psilocybin mushrooms for personal use and share them without payment; sale of personal-use natural medicine is prohibited.

provider_requirements.text: Regulated services are delivered by DORA-licensed facilitators, mostly at licensed healing centres.

risk_notes.text: Psilocybin remains a Schedule I substance under federal law.

arbitrage_summary.text: Colorado: licensed psilocybin services plus personal-use cultivation; no lawful retail microdose market for personal-use product.
